name: Pastors Authority In The Church
overview: Scripture reveals that the authority of pastors in the church is derived from Christ’s sovereign power and His appointment of leaders to shepherd His people. Jesus, who holds all power in heaven and earth, entrusts pastors and elders as overseers to care for the church, which He purchased with His own blood. Pastors are part of the divinely appointed ministry gifts given to equip and nurture the body of Christ, ensuring the unity of one fold under one shepherd. This authority is exercised with responsibility to feed and protect the flock, under the guidance of the Holy Spirit.
